title: Beyond the 956: María Alicia Delgado, beloved Mexican actress and comedian, dies at 77
excerpt: Mexican actress and comedian María Alicia Delgado has died at 77. Televisa Espectáculos confirmed her death on Wednesday, November 4, 2026; she was remembered for a television career of more than four decades, including ¡Anabel!, Derbez en cuando and Cero en conducta.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Mexican actress and comedian María Alicia Delgado has died at 77.

Delgado died on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. Her death was confirmed by Televisa Espectáculos through its official social media accounts, which offered condolences to her family, friends and the public who followed her career. No official cause of death was disclosed.

Born on March 18, 1949, in Monterrey, Nuevo León, Delgado built a television career spanning more than four decades as an actress, comedian and announcer. She made her television debut in 1984 on the children's program El tesoro del saber, playing Marilú.

Her national breakthrough came in 1988 with the comedy show ¡Anabel!, where she played La Abuela alongside Anabel Ferreira and Eugenio Derbez, remaining with the program through 1996. She went on to work with Derbez again on Derbez en cuando, and appeared in Cero en conducta and Odisea Burbujas, programs that made her a familiar face to generations of Mexican television viewers.

Delgado also appeared in numerous telenovelas, including Serafín, Amorcito Corazón, De que te quiero, te quiero, La vecina and Enamorándome de Ramón, with her final telenovela reported as Monteverde. In a 2025 interview she said she had no plans to retire from acting.

Rest in Peace, María Alicia Delgado.

Sources: Televisa Espectáculos, confirming her death; Las Estrellas; Milenio; El Universal.
